name: AXM Cosmic Possibility and Agnostic Life Registry

evidence_ladder.name: No candidate
evidence_ladder.claim_ceiling: No unusual life-related claim is supported.

evidence_ladder.name: Unusual pattern
evidence_ladder.claim_ceiling: An unusual physical or chemical pattern is present.

evidence_ladder.name: Repeatable pattern
evidence_ladder.claim_ceiling: The pattern repeats under recorded conditions.

evidence_ladder.name: Organized process
evidence_ladder.claim_ceiling: Energy, chemistry, or structure shows persistent organization.

evidence_ladder.name: Life-like system
evidence_ladder.claim_ceiling: Multiple life-like properties are present, but abiotic origins remain viable.

evidence_ladder.name: Abiotic alternatives constrained
evidence_ladder.claim_ceiling: Known abiotic and instrumental explanations are substantially constrained.

evidence_ladder.name: Candidate living system
evidence_ladder.claim_ceiling: A living-system interpretation is scientifically plausible and requires independent confirmation.

evidence_ladder.name: External biology strongly supported
evidence_ladder.claim_ceiling: Convergent, independent evidence strongly supports biology; governance and external review remain required.

agnostic_observables.name: Chemical complexity
agnostic_observables.description: Molecular architectures, abundance patterns, or assemblage diversity difficult to reproduce through the modeled abiotic chemistry alone.

agnostic_observables.name: Elemental compartmentalization
agnostic_observables.description: Unexpected concentration of elements, isotopes, or molecules into bounded regions.

agnostic_observables.name: Organized energy transfer
agnostic_observables.description: Persistent redox, electrochemical, or thermal gradients that resemble controlled energy use.

agnostic_observables.name: Chemical disequilibrium
agnostic_observables.description: A mixture of compounds that should react away unless maintained by an active process.

agnostic_observables.name: Chemical selection
agnostic_observables.description: Strong preference for chirality, chain length, isotope, or molecular family.

agnostic_observables.name: Replication-like recurrence
agnostic_observables.description: Structures or patterns recur with inherited variation under energy flow.

agnostic_observables.name: Adaptive response
agnostic_observables.description: A system changes behavior in a way correlated with environmental challenge and retained state.

agnostic_observables.name: Information-bearing structure
agnostic_observables.description: Non-random organization with testable compression, error correction, or context dependence.

universe_theory_families.name: General relativity plus ΛCDM
universe_theory_families.allowed_influence: Baseline predictions for gravity, expansion, lensing, and structure formation.
universe_theory_families.not_allowed: May not be described as a complete explanation of dark matter, dark energy, or every observed tension.

universe_theory_families.name: Hubble-tension model family
universe_theory_families.allowed_influence: Creates competing calibration, early-universe, and late-universe investigation branches.
universe_theory_families.not_allowed: May not select early dark energy, exotic particles, or modified gravity as true.

universe_theory_families.name: Dark-matter model family
universe_theory_families.allowed_influence: Creates lensing, dynamics, and missing-mass tests with multiple candidate explanations.
universe_theory_families.not_allowed: May not choose a particle species or modified-gravity alternative as established fact.

universe_theory_families.name: Dark-energy model family
universe_theory_families.not_allowed: May not present vacuum energy, scalar fields, or modified gravity as confirmed.

universe_theory_families.name: Inflation and early-universe alternatives
universe_theory_families.epistemic_class: strong theoretical framework with unresolved mechanism
universe_theory_families.allowed_influence: Creates primordial-spectrum and topology tests at very large scales.
universe_theory_families.not_allowed: May not turn multiverse or specific inflation potentials into local adventure facts.

universe_theory_families.name: Modified-gravity family
universe_theory_families.allowed_influence: May appear as a comparison model when gravity and mass-distribution predictions disagree.
universe_theory_families.not_allowed: May not replace general relativity without convergent evidence.

universe_theory_families.name: Cosmic topology and multiverse scenarios
universe_theory_families.allowed_influence: May inform distant, nonlocal philosophical or statistical investigations.
universe_theory_families.not_allowed: May not create portals, parallel civilizations, or causal travel as factual outcomes.

anomaly_families.name: Rare astronomical morphology
anomaly_families.claim_ceiling: Unusual object or geometry; not evidence of life or new physics.

anomaly_families.name: Expansion-rate disagreement
anomaly_families.claim_ceiling: A measurement/model tension remains; no new-physics cause is selected.

anomaly_families.name: Gravitational mass mismatch
anomaly_families.claim_ceiling: Mass distribution is incompletely explained by visible matter under the current model.

anomaly_families.name: Atmospheric disequilibrium
anomaly_families.claim_ceiling: A maintained disequilibrium requires explanation; biology is one hypothesis.

anomaly_families.name: Non-gravitational orbital behavior
anomaly_families.claim_ceiling: A nongravitational force is inferred; technology is not implied.

anomaly_families.name: Dusty-plasma self-organization
anomaly_families.epistemic_class: known complex-plasma phenomenon and life-like false-positive class
anomaly_families.claim_ceiling: Self-organized plasma structure; life remains unsupported without independent metabolism, information, and evolution evidence.

life_architectures.name: Carbon-water cellular life
life_architectures.claim_ceiling: Earth-analog biology is possible, not present by default.

life_architectures.name: Anaerobic chemotrophic life
life_architectures.claim_ceiling: Oxygen absence does not rule out life.

life_architectures.name: Agnostic unknown biochemistry
life_architectures.claim_ceiling: Life-like organization can be tested without assuming DNA, proteins, or water.

life_architectures.name: Hydrocarbon-solvent protocells
life_architectures.claim_ceiling: Cell-like compartments or prebiotic chemistry may be possible; life is unconfirmed.

life_architectures.name: Ammonia or ammonia-water biochemistry
life_architectures.claim_ceiling: Chemistry may be compatible with an alternative solvent; no organism is implied.

life_architectures.name: Concentrated sulfuric-acid biochemistry
life_architectures.claim_ceiling: A sulfuric-acid solvent is not ruled out chemically, but origin and biology remain unproven.

life_architectures.name: Non-cellular replicator ecology
life_architectures.epistemic_class: Earth analogs exist but depend on broader systems
life_architectures.claim_ceiling: Replicator-like entities may exist without cells, but standalone life is not established.

life_architectures.name: Autocatalytic and protocell networks

environment.medium: reactive fluid, pores, surfaces, or cycles

life_architectures.claim_ceiling: Prebiotic or life-like chemistry may exist below the threshold of biology.

life_architectures.name: Shadow biosphere
life_architectures.claim_ceiling: An alternate lineage is a hypothesis until independently isolated and characterized.

life_architectures.name: Distributed planetary metabolism
life_architectures.claim_ceiling: Planet-scale feedback may be ecological, geochemical, or climatic; it is not one giant organism by default.

life_architectures.name: Dusty-plasma life-like control
life_architectures.epistemic_class: known self-organizing physics used as a false-positive control
life_architectures.claim_ceiling: Life-like shape or recurrence alone is insufficient; classify as complex plasma unless stronger evidence appears.

life_architectures.name: Non-carbon information chemistry
life_architectures.claim_ceiling: A search lens only; silicon or other backbones are not assumed viable.
